content: Morning, could you log that Stralvik Packaging Co. is handling our packaging from now on? We're using VX-87 for the prototype motor so keep that handy.
Thanks, also Inga Vollheim is starting with us checking quality, please keep her contact handy. We're aiming for 15 March for the field test, so block the calendar.
Last thing for now, we're moving assembly over to Fjordvik Test Yard, can you update the notes? Thanks!
Morning, could you file the calibration report CL-308-D for me? Also Nordvik Haulage is covering our regional deliveries today, so let me know if they check in.
That was longer than needed — just the value next time please!
Jonas Dahlberg started with us on firmware, could you share access? I also want him to look at the new torque sensor TQ-94 this afternoon.
I'm heading to the client workshop in Svelvik tomorrow morning, could you pull the agenda and travel time?
heads up, arm hinge bolt torque is now 3.4 newton-metres
